capabilities: Insert inline handwriting sections between paragraphs in markdown notes
Draw with fountain pen, calligraphy nib, marker, and pencil using stylus pressure and twist
Erase strokes and pan or zoom the canvas
Recognize handwriting as text with MyScript or Google Cloud Vision OCR
Auto-save stroke data to JSON files and store handwriting as code blocks
disambiguation: Despite the Khattat name (calligrapher), it is a general handwriting and annotation tool, not a calligraphy-font plugin.
extras: Not yet available in the community plugin store; the README says it is 'currently in review' and must be installed manually from GitHub. OCR requires a provider account and API keys; free tiers are 2000 requests/month (MyScript) and 1000 requests/month (Google Cloud Vision). Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite or sketch with a stylus inside notes or to convert handwriting into text.

requires.name: MyScript (App Key + HMAC Key) or Google Cloud Vision API key

summary: Handwriting plugin that embeds inline drawing canvases in markdown notes with realistic pens and OCR handwriting recognition via MyScript or Google Cloud Vision.
